rows.evidence: Voice is plain, exact and dry throughout and matches BRAND.md: 'It never stops a call and never changes one: it prints nothing and always exits 0' (index-1440-mid.png y 133-197), the six-row limits table with 4,000 characters, 20 MB, 20,000 files, the project directory, symlinks, the end of the log (y 880-1462), 'Not on PyPI yet' (index-1440-tail.png y 1103-1135), Planned tags on Cloud (index-1440-foot.png y 480-495). Faults: (1) 'Join the waitlist (a GitHub issue)' and 'The waitlist is a GitHub issue: say what you would pay for, and that decides what gets built first' (index-1440-foot.png y 576-640) assert a waitlist process the README and BRAND.md do not contain; 'and your team' in 'Cloud sync of session history across your machines and your team' (y 688) is also beyond BRAND.md, which says cloud sync only; (2) the install panel opens with '# or: pip install git+https://...' before the pipx line it is an alternative to (index-1440-tail.png y 1249), which reads backwards, and the README puts it after; (3) headings that talk about the page's own honesty ('Cloud is planned, and says so', 'Plain answers', 'What is planned is marked planned') lean on the virtue instead of showing it, and 'nothing it does is final' in the hero is stronger than the limits table allows (files over 20 MB, outside the project, git-ignored are not restored); (4) the FAQ answers were closed in every render, so I could not read or check them.

Cut 'and your team'. Move the 'or: pip install' comment below the pipx line. Change the hero last sentence to 'Every step it takes can be taken back, within the limits below' (or keep, but link 'limits'). Ship one render with every FAQ open so the answers can be read.
